results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if the target custom object is unknown)] [Prerequisite]: List available custom objects using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_CUSTOM_OBJECTS (pick the correct API name).
[Optional (if field or relationship API names are unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Inspect fields on the custom object and Contact using SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT (avoid invalid SELECT/updates).

[Required] [Prerequisite]: Fetch target custom-object rows using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (apply filters; paginate until done; use SALESFORCE_QUERY_ALL instead when soft-deleted/archived rows must be included).
[Required] [Step]: Parse SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY results to collect source record Id, related Contact Id, and any mapping keys (handle nested relationship objects under records).
[Optional (if related Contact Id/lookup is missing)] [Step]: Resolve the correct related record using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (match on available attributes/keys).
[Required] [Step]: Repair/set the source-object lookup using SALESFORCE_SOBJECT_ROWS_UPDATE (write only when the computed value differs).
[Required] [Step]: Compute target Contact custom-field values and apply updates using SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT (process in cautious batches for large result sets).
[Optional (for spot-checking)] [Next Step]: Fetch a representative record using SALESFORCE_GET_S_OBJECT_RECORD (confirm final field values on source and/or Contact).
[Fallback (if update responses are empty/unclear)] [Fallback]: Verify updated Contact records using SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY (re-query by Id and select updated fields).
known_pitfalls: [SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT] Success may return no body (HTTP 204 semantics); rely on a follow-up read when confirmation is required.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] 400 INVALID_FIELD if any field API name is wrong/unavailable; validate via SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Results are under data.records with done/totalSize; don’t assume a flat list or single page.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Relationship selections return nested objects; downstream mapping must read nested keys rather than flat strings.
[SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY] Aggregate queries return AggregateResult-style rows (often in data.records[0]) keyed by alias; SUM(...) may be null on empty sets.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Deduplicate queried records from a saved payload before batching updates
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import json
payload=json.loads(raw_json)
records=payload["data"]["records"]
seen=set();out=[]
for r in records:
    i=r.get("Id")
    if i and i not in seen:
        seen.add(i);out.append(r)
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=salesforce. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="salesforce") to create a connection BEFORE executing any salesforce tools.

SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

examples: SELECT Id, Name, Email FROM Contact WHERE CreatedDate > 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
SELECT Name, (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts) FROM Account
SELECT COUNT() FROM Lead WHERE Status = 'New'
SELECT COUNT(Id), StageName FROM Opportunity GROUP BY StageName
SELECT Id, Name FROM Opportunity ORDER BY Amount DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'O\'Brien'
SELECT Id, Name, Description FROM Account LIMIT 10
query.description: SOQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT. Field names must match object schema exactly — use SALESFORCE_GET_ALL_FIELDS_FOR_OBJECT for unfamiliar objects. ALIASES: No 'AS' keyword (use 'SUM(Amount) TotalSales' NOT 'SUM(Amount) AS TotalSales'). AGGREGATES: Without GROUP BY, ORDER BY/LIMIT not allowed (single-row result). COUNT() SYNTAX: Bare COUNT() only valid alone. With GROUP BY or other fields, must specify field: COUNT(Id) or COUNT(fieldName). Example: 'SELECT COUNT(Id), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status' NOT 'SELECT COUNT(), Status FROM Lead GROUP BY Status'. NON-GROUPABLE: Long text, rich text, encrypted text, compound address/location fields. NON-FILTERABLE: Long text area, rich text, encrypted text, multi-select picklists, blob fields CANNOT be in WHERE. FIELDS(ALL)/FIELDS(CUSTOM) require LIMIT ≤200. ID values need single quotes. Apostrophes use backslash: 'O\'Brien'.

SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT.description: Updates an existing contact in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated. Returns HTTP 204 with no body on success; use SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT to verify applied changes. Org-level validation rules, duplicate rules, or field-level permissions may reject correctly formatted requests with HTTP 400; inspect the error response to identify the constraint.
